# nvm cache remove metadata

Remove cached metadata files.

## Usage

```powershell
nvm cache remove metadata [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `--prompt` | `-p` | Interactive selection for metadata files. |

## Examples

```powershell
nvm cache remove metadata
nvm cache remove metadata --prompt
```
